div.div: 1 · Gap: the CI token may create any Application in namespace argocd, and an Application can name the default project, which on mk4 allows every repository, namespace and cluster-wide kind. Restrict the default project, or the token is cluster-admin by another name.

text.tspan: 1 · Gap: the CI token may create any Application in namespace argocd, and an Application can name the default project, which on mk4 allows every repository, namespace and
